scope: surgical-tool instance detection and segmentation for downstream 6D pose
id_policy: canonical_id follows the existing prototype and ROS2 handoff IDs. Source dataset IDs are never interpreted without source_mappings.

excluded_source_classes.policy: Exclude from training labels, model output, evaluation, and ROS2 surgical-tool observations.

classes.name: Hand_request
classes.meaning: a hand/action state indicating a request for a tool

classes.name: Hand_Not_Request
classes.meaning: a hand/action state indicating no tool request

classes.name: Hand_with_tool
classes.meaning: a hand/tool interaction state; it does not identify the held tool

rules: Every visible instance of every canonical tool class must be annotated in an eligible image.
verified_empty means a human verified that no canonical tool is visible.
Hand source classes 6, 7, and 8 are discarded; any visible held surgical tool must still be annotated with its tool identity.
partial_known and needs_second_review are workflow statuses, never model classes, and are excluded from training until completed.
excluded_ambiguous is an image-level terminal exclusion for occlusion or motion cases whose class-specific geometry cannot be trusted.
SAM-family masks generated from boxes are pseudo-annotations and require independent mask QC.

general: Annotate the visible rigid surgical-tool geometry only.
Never include the hand, glove, cable, drape, or background in a tool mask.
For an occluded tool, annotate only its visible tool pixels; do not hallucinate hidden geometry.

class_specific.Scalpel: Scalpel and Knife handle are the same canonical class; include the visible knife handle and attached blade as one rigid tool instance.
class_specific.Bovie: Include the rigid pencil body and electrode tip; exclude cable and hand.
class_specific.Bipolar Forceps: Include the visible rigid instrument; exclude cable and hand.
